query:
SELECT 
  q.id as quote_id, q.panel_beater_name, q.total_amount, q.status,
  qi.id as item_id, qi.component_name, qi.description, qi.unit_price, qi.quantity, qi.total_price, qi.repair_type
FROM quotes q
LEFT JOIN quote_items qi ON qi.quote_id = q.id
WHERE q.claim_id = '6240003'
ORDER BY q.id, qi.id
LIMIT 100;
